review:
Benji Killed In Vegas is a 5x3 crime slot set on the Strip. Its Dead Presidents Nudge is triggered when a premium symbol lands fully on one of the first three reels, pulling matching pieces into view elsewhere. A three-row xNudge Wild always becomes fully visible, adding +1 to its multiplier per nudge.

Two scatters give a dice respin, turning them into x2 and x3 overlay multipliers. Three scatters award nine VEGA$ Spins with x2, x3 and x4 overlays. xSplit also appears. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x maximum.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
